keyPoints.en: Local communities resisted to defend their sovereignty, religion, customs and rights.
keyPoints.bm: Masyarakat tempatan menentang untuk mempertahankan kedaulatan, agama, adat dan hak mereka.

keyPoints.en: Armed resistance in the 19th century: Dol Said, Yam Tuan Antah, Dato' Bahaman, Rentap, Sharif Masahor.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan bersenjata abad ke-19: Dol Said, Yam Tuan Antah, Dato' Bahaman, Rentap, Sharif Masahor.

keyPoints.en: Armed resistance in the 20th century: Tok Janggut, Mat Salleh, Mat Sator.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan bersenjata abad ke-20: Tok Janggut, Mat Salleh, Mat Sator.

keyPoints.en: Other forms: challenging treaties and using the legal system.
keyPoints.bm: Bentuk lain: mencabar perjanjian dan menggunakan sistem perundangan.

meaning.en: Fighting with weapons against colonial forces.
meaning.bm: Bertempur dengan senjata menentang tentera penjajah.

meaning.en: Opposing through refusal, protest letters, treaties or the courts.
meaning.bm: Menentang melalui keengganan, surat bantahan, perjanjian atau mahkamah.

points.en: Dol Said (Naning, 1831–1832): refused to pay one-tenth of produce to the British.
points.bm: Dol Said (Naning, 1831–1832): enggan membayar sepersepuluh hasil kepada British.

points.en: Yam Tuan Antah (Negeri Sembilan, 1875): opposed British interference in Sungai Ujong.
points.bm: Yam Tuan Antah (Negeri Sembilan, 1875): menentang campur tangan British di Sungai Ujong.

points.en: Dato' Bahaman (Pahang, 1891–1895), with Mat Kilau: angered by loss of chiefs' power.
points.bm: Dato' Bahaman (Pahang, 1891–1895), bersama Mat Kilau: marah akibat kehilangan kuasa pembesar.

points.en: Rentap and Sharif Masahor (Sarawak): fought the Brookes.
points.bm: Rentap dan Sharif Masahor (Sarawak): menentang Brooke.

points.en: Tok Janggut (Pasir Puteh, Kelantan, 1915): against new taxes and land rules.
points.bm: Tok Janggut (Pasir Puteh, Kelantan, 1915): menentang cukai baharu dan peraturan tanah.

points.en: Mat Salleh (Sabah, 1894–1900): against the BNBC's taxes and interference.
points.bm: Mat Salleh (Sabah, 1894–1900): menentang cukai dan campur tangan SBUB.

points.en: Mat Sator in Sabah continued resistance after Mat Salleh.
points.bm: Mat Sator di Sabah meneruskan penentangan selepas Mat Salleh.

heading.en: Challenging treaties and using the law
heading.bm: Mencabar perjanjian dan menggunakan sistem perundangan

points.en: Some rulers and chiefs disputed treaties and refused to follow them.
points.bm: Sesetengah raja dan pembesar mempertikaikan perjanjian dan enggan mematuhinya.

points.en: Haji Abdul Rahman Limbong (Terengganu) defended farmers in court against land permit rules before the 1928 uprising.
points.bm: Haji Abdul Rahman Limbong (Terengganu) membela petani di mahkamah menentang peraturan permit tanah sebelum kebangkitan 1928.

question.en: State TWO aims of local resistance.
question.bm: Nyatakan DUA matlamat penentangan masyarakat tempatan.

answer.en: To defend the sovereignty of the state and the power of local leaders; to protect religion, customs and the people's rights (e.g. from unfair taxes).
answer.bm: Mempertahankan kedaulatan negeri dan kuasa pemimpin tempatan; melindungi agama, adat dan hak rakyat (cth. daripada cukai yang tidak adil).

keyPoints.en: Western administration took power away from local rulers and chiefs.
keyPoints.bm: Pentadbiran Barat mengambil kuasa daripada raja dan pembesar tempatan.

keyPoints.en: It replaced local laws and took over local finances, such as the right to collect taxes.
keyPoints.bm: Ia menggantikan undang-undang tempatan dan mengambil alih kewangan tempatan, seperti hak memungut cukai.

keyPoints.en: Ordinary people suffered from new taxes, land permits and rules that ignored their customs.
keyPoints.bm: Rakyat biasa menderita akibat cukai baharu, permit tanah dan peraturan yang mengabaikan adat mereka.

meaning.en: Rulers and chiefs could no longer make decisions in their own areas.
meaning.bm: Raja dan pembesar tidak lagi boleh membuat keputusan di kawasan masing-masing.

meaning.en: Permission (and fee) needed to open or use land.
meaning.bm: Kebenaran (dan bayaran) yang diperlukan untuk membuka atau menggunakan tanah.

points.en: 1. Local government: Residents and officers took over decisions.
points.bm: 1. Pemerintahan tempatan: Residen dan pegawai mengambil alih keputusan.

points.en: 2. Local laws: Western laws and courts replaced many customs.
points.bm: 2. Perundangan tempatan: undang-undang dan mahkamah Barat menggantikan banyak adat.

points.en: 3. Local finance: chiefs lost the right to collect taxes; the British collected them.
points.bm: 3. Kewangan tempatan: pembesar hilang hak memungut cukai; British yang memungutnya.

points.en: New taxes on land, produce, boats and even buffaloes; permits for land and forest products.
points.bm: Cukai baharu ke atas tanah, hasil, perahu dan juga kerbau; permit untuk tanah dan hasil hutan.

points.en: Customs such as kerah and debt-bondage were banned without understanding local society.
points.bm: Adat seperti kerah dan perhambaan hutang diharamkan tanpa memahami masyarakat tempatan.

question.en: Why did the Residential System anger Malay chiefs?
question.bm: Mengapakah Sistem Residen menimbulkan kemarahan pembesar Melayu?

answer.en: They lost their traditional powers and the right to collect taxes, which was their main source of income.
answer.bm: Mereka kehilangan kuasa tradisional dan hak memungut cukai, yang merupakan sumber pendapatan utama mereka.

keyPoints.en: Local resistance had strengths: unity (muafakat), forts, weapons and use of the law.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan tempatan mempunyai kekuatan: muafakat, kubu pertahanan, persenjataan dan perundangan.

keyPoints.en: It also had weaknesses: limited weapons, Western legal threats, failure to interpret treaties and British trickery.
keyPoints.bm: Ia juga mempunyai kelemahan: senjata yang terhad, ancaman perundangan Barat, gagal mentafsir perjanjian dan tipu muslihat British.

keyPoints.en: Most resistance failed against the better-armed British forces.
keyPoints.bm: Kebanyakan penentangan gagal menghadapi tentera British yang lebih lengkap bersenjata.

meaning.en: Agreement and unity among leaders before acting.
meaning.bm: Persetujuan dan perpaduan dalam kalangan pemimpin sebelum bertindak.

meaning.en: Defensive stronghold, e.g. Mat Salleh's fort at Tambunan, Rentap's fort at Bukit Sadok.
meaning.bm: Kubu pertahanan, cth. kubu Mat Salleh di Tambunan, kubu Rentap di Bukit Sadok.

points.en: 1. Muafakat: e.g. Perak chiefs met and agreed to remove Birch (1875).
points.bm: 1. Muafakat: cth. pembesar Perak bermesyuarat dan bersetuju menyingkirkan Birch (1875).

points.en: 2. Forts in hills and jungle that were hard to attack.
points.bm: 2. Kubu di bukit dan hutan yang sukar diserang.

points.en: 3. Weapons: traditional weapons and some firearms; knowledge of the land.
points.bm: 3. Persenjataan: senjata tradisional dan sedikit senjata api; pengetahuan tentang kawasan.

points.en: 4. Law: some leaders used legal arguments and the courts.
points.bm: 4. Perundangan: sesetengah pemimpin menggunakan hujah undang-undang dan mahkamah.

points.en: 1. Armed struggle against modern guns, cannons and trained troops.
points.bm: 1. Penentangan bersenjata menghadapi senapang moden, meriam dan tentera terlatih.

points.en: 2. Threat of Western law — leaders were tried, hanged or exiled.
points.bm: 2. Ancaman perundangan Barat — pemimpin dibicarakan, digantung atau dibuang negeri.

points.en: 3. Failing to interpret treaties — e.g. not realising what "advice" in the Pangkor Treaty meant.
points.bm: 3. Gagal mentafsir perjanjian — cth. tidak menyedari maksud "nasihat" dalam Perjanjian Pangkor.

points.en: 4. British trickery, e.g. false promises and bribing local informers.
points.bm: 4. Tipu muslihat British, cth. janji palsu dan merasuah pemberi maklumat tempatan.

alt.bm: Tugu di Tambunan, Sabah, menandakan tapak kubu Mat Salleh, tempat beliau gugur pada 1900.

question.en: Why did most local resistance fail?

answer.en: The British had modern weapons and more troops; resistance was local and not united; and the British used trickery and the law against the leaders.
answer.bm: British mempunyai senjata moden dan tentera yang lebih ramai; penentangan bersifat setempat dan tidak bersatu; dan British menggunakan tipu muslihat serta undang-undang terhadap pemimpin.

keyPoints.en: Resistance affected both the British administration and the local community.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan memberi kesan kepada pentadbiran British dan masyarakat tempatan.

keyPoints.en: The British strengthened their control but also became more careful with local customs.
keyPoints.bm: British mengukuhkan kawalan tetapi juga lebih berhati-hati dengan adat tempatan.

keyPoints.en: Many leaders were killed, hanged or exiled — but their courage inspired later nationalists.
keyPoints.bm: Ramai pemimpin terbunuh, digantung atau dibuang negeri — tetapi keberanian mereka memberi inspirasi kepada nasionalis kemudian.

meaning.en: Sending someone away from his homeland as punishment, e.g. Sultan Abdullah to the Seychelles.
meaning.bm: Menghantar seseorang keluar dari tanah airnya sebagai hukuman, cth. Sultan Abdullah ke Seychelles.

meaning.en: A person admired for courage in defending the homeland.
meaning.bm: Orang yang disanjung kerana keberanian mempertahankan tanah air.

points.en: Military control was strengthened; more police and forts.
points.bm: Kawalan ketenteraan diperkukuh; lebih banyak polis dan kubu.

points.en: British officers were told to respect Malay customs and work through rulers (indirect rule).
points.bm: Pegawai British diarah menghormati adat Melayu dan bekerja melalui raja (pemerintahan tidak langsung).

points.en: Leaders punished: Dato' Maharaja Lela hanged; Sultan Abdullah exiled to the Seychelles; Haji Abdul Rahman Limbong exiled to Mecca.
points.bm: Pemimpin dihukum: Dato' Maharaja Lela digantung; Sultan Abdullah dibuang ke Seychelles; Haji Abdul Rahman Limbong dibuang ke Mekah.

points.en: The spirit of patriotism lived on and inspired the nationalist movement of the 20th century.
points.bm: Semangat patriotisme terus hidup dan memberi inspirasi kepada gerakan nasionalisme abad ke-20.

question.en: What was the long-term significance of local resistance?
question.bm: Apakah kepentingan jangka panjang penentangan tempatan?

answer.en: It showed that people were willing to sacrifice for their homeland and inspired later nationalists who won independence peacefully.
answer.bm: Ia menunjukkan rakyat sanggup berkorban demi tanah air dan memberi inspirasi kepada nasionalis kemudian yang mencapai kemerdekaan secara aman.
